tool_args.title: Incident Post-Mortem Report: INC-8892 - SEV-1 Distributed PostgreSQL Telemetry Cluster Outage
tool_args.content:
# Incident Post-Mortem: INC-8892 (SEV-1)

## Overview
- **Affected Service**: Distributed PostgreSQL Telemetry Cluster (Prod US-East)
- **Severity**: SEV-1 (CRITICAL)
- **Summary**: Replication lag exceeded 450s during peak traffic, triggering automatic failover that caused a temporary split-brain partition and corrupted telemetry sequence IDs.

## Timeline & Root Cause Analysis
1. Peak traffic surge triggered high write amplification.
2. Replication lag crossed 450s threshold.
3. Automated failover initiated while network jitter was high, resulting in split-brain state.
4. Sequence IDs diverged across nodes, leading to telemetry ingestion errors.

## Corrective Actions & Prevention
- Implement Patroni consensus raft leader election.
- Add Redis-based sequence ID replay deduplication layer.
- Configure advanced Datadog synthetic canary alerts for lag > 30s.
